daily.today_energy: Your emotional radar is super sharp today. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your internal GPS right now. It's giving introspective energy, and honestly, that's exactly what you need.
daily.love: Someone's vibes are shifting in your direction. Whether it's deepening an existing connection or noticing new chemistry, the universe is creating space for something real. Stay open.
daily.career: Your ideas have serious momentum today. This is the moment to pitch that thing you've been sitting on. Your voice carries weight—use it.

weekly.overview: This week invites you to trust your intuition more than usual. The cosmic energy is pushing you toward authenticity—stop dimming your light for comfort. Your sensitivity is your superpower, not a flaw.
weekly.love: Whether single or coupled, vulnerability is your love language this week. Someone's noticing the real you beneath the armor. Let yourself be seen, even if it feels scary. Connection deepens through honesty.
weekly.career: Your creative ideas are hitting different right now. Don't sleep on that project or passion you've been sitting on. Your professional energy is magnetic—colleagues want to collaborate with the actual you.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Lean into rest without guilt. Movement that feels nourishing (not punishing) is your vibe. Listen to what your nervous system needs—it knows best.
